description: Clean, beginner-friendly, guided onboarding and configuration flows for Vrooli as a whole. This is meant to become a guide for first-time users and non-technical people. It should guide you through setting up resources (starting with coding agents) and adding secrets, opening vrooli-autoheal to configure autoheal settings, opening prompt-manager to configure skills and teams, and things like that (not actually sure what else, or how the UX should be exactly)
name: vrooli-onboarding
title: Vrooli Onboarding
